mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 2.25% for three consecutive months reduces expected discount rates, lowering the present value of future equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.25% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in this regime are not statistically lower than in a neutral rate zone (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the 3-month rate hold persists beyond 6 months without reversal.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL monthly inflation rate exceeds 0.3% for two consecutive months, market expectations for future Fed rate cuts diminish, causing a short-term spike in equity valuations and positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns do not outperform a 2-month rolling average during the inflation spike (p > 0.05), or the CPIAUCSL reverts below 0.3% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly PAYEMS (employment growth) of at least 0.5% coincides with stronger consumer demand and reduced business uncertainty, driving a 5-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% in a single month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the PAYEMS surge, or employment growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (goods orders) grows by more than 3% in a quarter, it indicates accelerating business demand that anticipates stronger earnings and supports a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns during high-GDPC1 quarters are not significantly higher than average (p > 0.05), or GDPC1 growth reverses in the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of 2% signals supply-side softness that raises uncertainty, prompting a 60-day S&P 500 forward return correction in the negative direction.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by 2% in a single month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns during INDPRO contractions are not consistently negative (p > 0.05), or INDPRO recovers in the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in RSAFS (reserves) exceeding 2% suggest continued accommodative monetary policy, which amplifies equity price sensitivity to rate expectations and drives a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by more than 2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns during reserve buildup are not higher than the prior 20-day average (p > 0.05), or reserve growth slows in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 4% for two consecutive months, it reflects strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and produce a 5-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns during low-unemployment months are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or the rate recedes below 3.5% in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (housing starts) and FEDFUNDS above 2% and 4.0% respectively creates a feedback loop where rate hikes are interpreted as less restrictive, sustaining equity valuations and producing a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% in the same month
regime_hint: coincidental housing expansion and aggressive Fed policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns during the interaction are not significantly higher than when either variable moves alone (p > 0.05), or the interaction persists for less than 2 months.
